commands_not_case_targeted.archive fork: publishes a verified archive as a new workspace
commands_not_case_targeted.archive pins release: removes stale archive pin records below local/pins, machine-local bookkeeping; it records nothing and names no case
commands_not_case_targeted.archive restore: publishes a verified archive as a new workspace
commands_not_case_targeted.demo: replays a fixture into a new workspace at an empty path
commands_not_case_targeted.export: writes files outside canonical state and records nothing
commands_not_case_targeted.init: creates a new workspace, which holds no case yet
commands_not_case_targeted.integration apply: changes one file the user names outside any workspace
commands_not_case_targeted.integration remove: changes one file the user names outside any workspace
commands_not_case_targeted.migrate: --apply changes the workspace format; case journals, blobs and IDs are never changed
commands_not_case_targeted.obsidian setup: --apply changes the viewer configuration folder and records nothing
commands_not_case_targeted.repair index: rebuilds the disposable index and records nothing; the fuzz runs it and checks every journal is unchanged
commands_not_case_targeted.repair journal: restores the witnessed bytes of reformatted journal files across every case and records nothing; it takes no case and changes no content (canonical_journal.rs)
commands_not_case_targeted.repair staging: retires finalized capture staging and records nothing
commands_not_case_targeted.retrospective: --consult records a consultation of another case's admitted lesson in --case; lessons::lessons_cross_cases_only_by_admission_and_explicit_consultation covers it
commands_not_case_targeted.vault copy-map: creates one human-owned board file and records nothing
commands_not_case_targeted.vault remove: deletes generated vault files and records nothing
commands_not_case_targeted.vault render: regenerates the vault projection and records nothing; the fuzz runs it and checks every journal is unchanged
